name: CX3D
patch_scope: Remove two unused JDK-internal imports; headless GUI initialization/repaint; use Math.PI for mutually consistent sphere volume and diameter conversions. Dynamics remain enabled. Scoped contact random stream restores the actual generator after synchronous contact execution, including exceptions. Optional post-operation observers record actual physical segment subdivision and merging without changing those operations. Refresh daughter cylinder coordinate axes after soma motion updates their spring axes; prevents off-surface contact attachment. Reject contact candidates whose stored axial attachment lies outside the current compressed cylinder; do not clamp or relocate them. Remeshing preserves synaptic site and spring ownership, shared coordinate arrays and independent bond endpoints; straight merges use the proximal length offset. Bond exchange acquires the locks it releases. Public mesh coarsening retains unequal diameters or different local coordinate frames instead of approximating their geometry; axis equality allows one ULP at unit-vector scale for normalization roundoff. Passive material-attachment calibration remains unvalidated; upstream biological retraction is outside this consumer path. Passive cylinder/soma deformation now transports each distinct attachment or bond coordinate array by its material fraction h/L. Active tip addition and remeshing retain their own rules. This uniform-strain no-slip assumption is not biologically calibrated.
